text:
olivia: Quick mock posted — compact mini-header for Playground. Key changes: streaming transcript flows under a thin header, Stop / Regenerate moved into header right, token rail collapsed to a single icon that expands on hover, prompt library quick-insert button next to composer. Screenshot: https://redwood.mock/mini-header.png (alt: 'mini header mock with token icon and header controls').
kevin: Nice! main question — moving Stop/Regenerate to the top: do we lose discoverability? Users expect controls near the input.
maria: Agree w/ kevin. Could we keep a small sticky Stop button near the stream and keep Regenerate in the header? Or show both on hover only.
diego: Accessibility note: if streaming uses aria-live="polite", screen readers won't interrupt. We should provide an explicit control to pause updates so SR users can read. Suggest aria-live="off" during pause with a toggle.
ux-bot: Accessibility checklist reminder: keyboard focus order must include token meter, prompt library, and Stop. Collapsed token icon needs an aria-label like 'token usage, 45 tokens used'. Ensure high contrast.
sam: Token counter concern — live-update every token is noisy and can be distracting. Can we debounce updates to ~250ms and show an interim ellipsis? Also show final token count and peak tokens after generation completes.
olivia: Good call. Debounce 200-300ms seems reasonable. UX question: should collapsed token icon show a quick hover preview of last 3 token types? might be overkill, leaning no.
kevin: I sketched keyboard flow: Tab sequence -> Prompt library -> Composer -> Send/Stop. If Stop is only in the header it breaks that flow. Option: duplicate Stop (header + composer) but keep Regenerate only in header.
maria: Copy nuance: 'Stop' vs 'Pause' — Pause implies resume. We want 'Stop' for cancel; maybe keep both: Pause (temporary halt of stream for SR/read) and Stop (cancel generation).
diego: Screen reader suggestion: announce when streaming completes: "Response complete — X tokens used" via a role="status" live region at the end. Also expose a control with aria-pressed state for pause.
olivia: Implementation detail for devs: small CSS for token badge: `.token-badge{ min-width:34px; font-size:12px }` fallback styles for high-contrast mode.
sam: Prompt library: quick-insert must be keyboard accessible with `aria-haspopup` and `aria-expanded`. Allow drag+drop from library into composer, but also a one-key insert.
maria: :thumbsup: Can we run a 6-person usability round focused on discoverability and screen-reader flow next Tues/Wed?
olivia: Yes — I'll book sessions. Action items: (1) Devs debounce tokens to 250ms (sam), (2) Add SR pause control + announce completion (diego), (3) Duplicate Stop in composer behind FF (kevin), (4) Update a11y checklist + docs (maria).
kevin: I'll PR the header layout and add composer duplicate button behind a feature-flag.
maria: Mobile nit — token icon must never overlap send button; on mobile it should be a bottom-left floating icon.
olivia: Copy tweak: change hover text from 'Prompt library' to 'Insert prompt' to reduce ambiguity.
diego: I'll update ARIA examples and add code snippets for pause/resume states in the a11y doc.
sam: I'll post a GIF prototype of the debounced live counter and hover token expand later today.
olivia: Thanks everyone :rocket:
